newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Huta Sendzimira steel mill eyes '99 listing.
newsitem.headline: Polish Huta Sendzimira steel mill eyes '99 listing.

text.p: Polish steel mill Huta Sendzimira SA, currently being privatised, seeks to enter the main market of the Warsaw bourse in 1999, its president said on Wednesday.
"I think the mill will enter the bourse in two years... which is an ambitious plan, though a realistic one," Jerzy Knapik told a news conference.
Under the privatization plan, three daughter companies will be carved out from the firm this year and later separately privatised through equity sales to strategic investors.
Knapik said foreign steel firms were interested in Sendzimir and that he would select one or two partners by the end of the first quarter next year.
He said at least two or three of the 22 subsidiaries the mill would have after the three firms are carved out would be listed on the bourse but he did not say which.
Huta Sendzimira, which employs 17,500 people, made a net profit of 14.3 million zlotys last year on sales of 2.9 billion zlotys.
